description: This file defines an immutable data transfer object (DTO) named AccountTransferData used for modeling account transfer information within the Fineract core project. It includes fields for transfer details, source and destination accounts, options for UI selections, and static factory methods for creating instances with various levels of detail.

classes.name: AccountTransferData
classes.description: Immutable data object representing an account transfer within Fineract, encapsulating transfer details, source and destination account info, and selection options.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Factory method to create a pre-filled transfer data template with provided account information and options, initializing transfer amount from the fromAccount if available.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Factory method to create a transfer data object with specified IDs, accounts, and date, for existing transfer records.

methods.name: transferBasicDetails
methods.description: Factory method to create a transfer data object with only basic details such as ID, currency, amount, date, and description, for minimal transfer representations.
